audience.text: Java developers building 3D applications who need a free, open-source library for basic scene graph construction, mesh processing, and STL file I/O without licensing or runtime dependencies.

capabilities.text: Detects 3D file formats automatically from file paths or binary streams using `FileFormat.detect` and `FileFormat.getFormatByExtension`.
capabilities.title: Automatic format detection

capabilities.text: Builds and traverses scene graphs using `Scene`, `Node.createChildNode`, and `Mesh` with control points and polygons.
capabilities.title: Scene graph construction

capabilities.text: Supports `LambertMaterial`, `PhongMaterial`, and `PbrMaterial` with configurable diffuse, ambient, specular, albedo, metallic, and roughness properties.
capabilities.title: Material system

capabilities.text: Reads and writes STL files in ASCII and binary formats using `StlLoadOptions` and `StlSaveOptions`.
capabilities.title: STL import and export

capabilities.text: Provides `Vector2`, `Vector3`, `Vector4`, `Matrix4`, `BoundingBox`, and `Transform` classes for geometric calculations and node transformations.
capabilities.title: Math utilities

capabilities.text: Constructs and inspects `NurbsCurve` instances with degree, order, knot vectors, and control points.
capabilities.title: NURBS curve support

limitations.text: Only STL import and export are fully functional; other format encoders are not wired up in this FOSS build.
Wavefront OBJ import does not currently work despite being format-detectable.
Some parametric primitives (`Pyramid`, `Torus`, `RectangularTorus`, `RevolvedAreaSolid`, `LinearExtrusion`) do not implement `toMesh()` conversion.

problems_solved.text: Enables Java developers to programmatically build and manipulate 3D scene graphs using a familiar API without commercial licensing.
Provides automatic format detection and loading for STL files, supporting both ASCII and binary representations.
Supports construction of parameterized primitives and IFC-style profiles for 3D modeling workflows.

product_summary.text: Aspose.3D FOSS for Java is a clean-room, open-source Java library implementing a subset of the Aspose.3D API for 3D scene graph manipulation, targeting Java 21 with no runtime dependencies.

uncertainties: The exact set of formats supported beyond STL is not fully specified beyond OBJ and STL mentions.
Whether `FileFormat` constants for non-STL formats (e.g., `WAVEFRONTOBJ`) are functional beyond detection is unclear.
The behavior of `Node` transform manipulation beyond `getTranslation`/`setTranslation` is not demonstrated in examples.

workflows.name: Load and re-export STL
workflows.text: Load an STL file using `Scene.fromFile` or `Scene.open` with `FileFormat.getFormatByExtension`, then save it in ASCII or binary STL format using `scene.save` with `FileFormat.STLASCII` or `FileFormat.STL_BINARY`.

workflows.name: Build scene from scratch
workflows.text: Create a `Scene`, add `Node` children with `Mesh` entities containing control points and polygons, then export to STL.

workflows.name: Inspect mesh properties
workflows.text: Access `Mesh` objects via `Node.getEntities`, then query control point count and polygon count using `getControlPoints().size()` and `getPolygonCount()`.

workflows.name: Apply materials
workflows.text: Create `LambertMaterial` or `PbrMaterial` instances with configurable colors, transparency, and reflection factors, then assign to scene entities.
